kext_inventory.role: Host NVMe bus driver managing queue creation, interrupt registration, and power management transitions
Host interface driver mediating access to cryptographic locker in Namespace 7
Administrative diagnostic driver querying NAND maturity, temperature, and wear-leveling band stats
Block device abstraction layer exposing Effaceable partitions to userland security daemons
XNU root storage family providing APFS block mapping and I/O buffer management

kernel_to_ans2.mechanism: Lockless circular ring submission via memory-mapped doorbells
kernel_to_ans2.direct_ring_buffer: Host writes 64-byte SQE into DRAM -> Issues 32-bit MMIO store to SQ Tail Doorbell (0x17dcc1000 + 16 * QID)
kernel_to_ans2.completion_flow: ANS2 DMA engine fetches SQE -> SART authorizes transfer -> AES-XTS pipeline processes beats -> Flash completes -> ANS2 DMA engine writes 16-byte CQE -> ANS2 asserts IRQ 0x3cd -> Host reaps and writes CQ Head Doorbell

sart_stage2_isolation.hypervisor_layer: Secure Page Table Monitor (SPTM) & Trusted Execution Monitor (TXM)
dma_containment: SPTM maps host queue pages into SART hardware table during IONVMeFamily queue initialization
ANS2 internal firmware cannot alter its own SART table entries; tables are locked in Stage-2 physical memory
Any out-of-bounds DMA request by rogue firmware triggers hardware SART bus error (LLT_WR_ERR / LLT_RD_ERR) and isolates coprocessor
effaceable_key_isolation: Namespace 7 keys are never exposed in plaintext to XNU or host DRAM
Secure Enclave unwraps volume keys directly into ANS2 AES hardware key slots over secure on-die fabric
